features.label: PDAC Approved L1932
features.text: Rigid anterior tibial section, total carbon-fiber prefabricated, includes fitting and adjustment for optimal support.

features.label: Carbon Fiber Design
features.text: Provides an excellent strength-to-weight ratio, ensuring lightweight and durable support.

features.label: Dynamic Gait Assistance
features.text: Tapered carbon heel stores energy and manages heel strike forces, while the full-length toe lever reduces shock to the contralateral limb.

features.label: Open Tibial Shell
features.text: Offers superior anatomical fit, reducing heat and perspiration for added comfort.

features.label: Versatile Support
features.text: Suitable for foot drop, ankle instability, mild knee instability, and other related conditions.

measurement: For the perfect fit, consult our sizing chart or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page. Available in sizes X-Small to Large for both left and right feet.
